name: aeo-engine-aeo-report
description: Run a free AI-visibility report on any website directly from Claude. The report measures how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude find, cite, and recommend a brand — with an overall visibility score, competitor gaps, and prioritized fixes. Provide a domain and the user's email; the report runs in ~10 minutes and returns a structured summary, a shareable report URL, and the full report by email. Two read-only tools, rate-limited and email-gated for fair use.

tool.description: Run the free AI-visibility report for a website (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude coverage, competitor gaps, prioritized fixes). Requires the user's real email — the finished report is emailed there and a shareable report URL is returned. Takes up to ~10 minutes; set wait_seconds up to 50 to wait inline, or poll later with get_aeo_report_status. Never fill the company field.

_published_faq.name: How do I add aeo-engine-aeo-report to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add aeo-engine-aeo-report to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://aeoengine.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is aeo-engine-aeo-report MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, aeo-engine-aeo-report scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is aeo-engine-aeo-report's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, aeo-engine-aeo-report scores 81/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 2 of 2 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the aeo-engine-aeo-report MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: aeo-engine-aeo-report provides these MCP tools: get_aeo_report_status and run_aeo_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to aeo-engine-aeo-report?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to aeo-engine-aeo-report in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
aeo-engine-aeo-report does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
aeo-engine-aeo-report is developed by AEO Engine. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
